final.summary: The factory records a planned ETP stop from 14:25 to 17:40 on 13 Oct with the equalization tank absorbing inflow. Tank level rose from 0.49 to 0.83 during the stop while outfall flow was zero and outfall pH stayed near neutral, indicating no untreated discharge during the stop. After restart ETP inflow and outfall flow resumed and tank level fell. ETP power data is missing from 14:00 to 23:40, so aeration cannot be confirmed for the period when the batch wastewater would be treated, and no lab BOD results are available.
